scope: Focused read-only semantic review: search/detail performance, initial reader cost, source badge compression, and article extraction
runtime_verification: NOT RUN: static source review on Windows, no iOS frame-time measurements and no target-site requests
schema_note: Graphify semantic fragment: source is caller and target is callee; confidence_tag distinguishes explicit relationships from inferred symptom causes.

nodes.label: Grouped result VStack
nodes.rationale: A lazy parent does not virtualize individual rows inside a plain child VStack.

nodes.label: RemoteImageLoader
nodes.rationale: Shared in-flight deduplication and off-main thumbnail decode already exist; do not claim all cover decoding occurs on main.

edges.relation: renders all books in a source group
can fan out initial cover tasks for an entire source group
can delay first interaction through full-window serialization work

hyperedges.relation: first usable detail page is gated by both tasks and a single isLoading branch

findings.claim: Grouped mode places every source's books inside one ordinary VStack. The parent LazyVStack virtualizes groups, not each book, so one 20+ book group creates its full row and cover-view subtree at once.
findings.fix: Flatten section headers and book rows into a stable-identity enum array consumed by one LazyVStack. Keep existing search ordering and source labels. Avoid nesting a plain eager book VStack.
findings.test: iOS 16 UI test with one source returning 100 rows: row-appearance/image-request counts near viewport initially; scrolling preserves identity and navigation. Profile Main Thread/SwiftUI body and frame p95 for 20/100/500 fixtures.

findings.claim: Detail and TOC requests are started concurrently, but the UI keeps showing only a spinner until refreshDetailAndTOC returns. It awaits detail first, so a fast TOC is hidden behind a slow detail request; a fast detail is likewise hidden while a slow TOC completes. This is UI first-paint gating, not evidence that all networking is serial or MainActor-blocking.
findings.fix: Show search-result placeholder detail immediately; track metadata and TOC loading/errors separately and publish each successful stage when it completes. Use an explicit event/task-group coordinator or actor-safe async child callbacks. Retry TOC with real tocUrl only when required, and retain visible successful data on partial failure.
findings.test: Fake SourceEngine tests: detail slow/TOC fast, detail fast/TOC slow, one fails, cancellation/source-switch; assert successful content appears before other request completes and stale result cannot replace a newer book.

findings.claim: publishIfNeeded awaits detached ranking and then writes model state without rechecking searchID, generation or cancellation. MainActor can run cancelSearch/startSearch while ranking is suspended; old results can overwrite a newer search despite the guard in the outer task-group loop.
findings.fix: Recheck activeSearchID == searchID, searchGeneration == generation and !Task.isCancelled immediately after await and before every publish. Use generation-scoped snapshots including match mode/filter state. Handle match-mode changes while ranking is suspended.
findings.test: Inject a ranking gate: start A, suspend ranking, cancel/start B, release A; assert only B owns visible results, flags, counters and errors.

findings.claim: Primary ranking already moved off MainActor, but each publication still filters then synchronously builds both grouped and aggregated arrays via results.didSet on MainActor, regardless of active display mode. Z-Library completion and applyMatchMode also perform full ranking on MainActor.

confidence.symptom_causality: INFERRED: 20 rows alone may not explain a hitch

findings.fix: Compute one immutable presentation snapshot off MainActor containing filtered rows and needed groups/aggregates, then publish once under a generation check. Keep value-only work off actor, avoid redundant @Published invalidations, and measure before adding complexity.
findings.test: Synthetic 20/200/2000-result benchmark measuring publish duration and frame p95 while scrolling; assert display-mode/filter changes produce identical ordering and duplicate policy.

findings.claim: The source card puts metadata, login, detail and 44pt menu in the same horizontal row. statusPill Text has no single-line or intrinsic-size protection; trailing action widths compress the metadata/badge HStack into the photographed vertical Legado layout.

confidence.basis: Exact source structure plus user screenshot

findings.fix: Separate metadata/header from a lower action row, use FlowLayout for status badges, and lineLimit(1)+fixedSize(horizontal:true,vertical:false) on each badge. Do not solve only with fixedSize if total header/actions still overflow; use compact layout at narrow width/large Dynamic Type.
findings.test: iOS 16 snapshots at widths 320/375/390/430 and Dynamic Type standard/accessibility, long source name/URL, logged-in label. Assert badge text remains horizontal and actions stay within card bounds.

findings.claim: Active scroll mode is WebScrollReaderView, not NativeReaderTextView. Every content revision builds/trims/transforms every paragraph in the chapter window and JSON-serializes the whole window synchronously on the UIKit update path. The JS side reuses unchanged DOM nodes but receives all paragraph text again; initial load builds all supplied chapters synchronously.

confidence.symptom_causality: INFERRED: requires device signposts; no observed FPS

findings.fix: Cache immutable encoded sections by contentSignature plus transform flags, build value-only text/JSON snapshots on a background worker, deliver generation-checked updates. Begin with current chapter and expand neighbors after content-ready/idle; send section patches where possible while preserving flat-index/anchor contracts. Do not disable anchor restoration or remove text to hide cost.
findings.test: Fixture with 1 vs 11 chapters and 1k/10k paragraphs, Simplified/Traditional and images. Record payload-build/serialization/DOM-ready timestamps, frames during immediate first swipe; assert exact content, stable chapter/paragraph anchor after prepend/append and TOC jump.

findings.claim: Extraction creates a second hidden WKWebView and reloads the original loadedURL instead of reading the visible web view's current DOM. User navigation inside the visible view is not reflected in loadedURL. Authenticated/JS-modified page state can be lost and the page is downloaded again; provisional-load failure has no completion handler.
findings.fix: Expose extraction from the existing visible WKWebView coordinator, evaluate its current document and current URL, parse captured HTML off MainActor, report exactly once, and cancel on dismiss/navigation generation. Reuse this path in SourceLoginView for extract-and-read. Preserve existing login cookie/session environment.
findings.test: Local WKURLSchemeHandler fixtures: initial page A navigates to B, DOM modified after load, authenticated/session content, provisional failure, dismiss during extraction. Assert B/current DOM is read without an extra request and spinner always terminates.

findings.claim: The selector includes body and chooses candidates.first in document order, so body normally wins over the nested article/main/content candidate. It then gathers nested p/headings/li from the broad root. Global paragraph deduplication also deletes legitimate repeated prose, not just adjacent boilerplate.
findings.fix: Score candidate roots by text density/length, link density, paragraph count and boilerplate penalty, prefer strongest specific article root over body; preserve paragraph order and legitimate repetition. Strip only targeted boilerplate or consecutive duplicates. Support common br/div novel content conservatively and retain nonempty short speech.
findings.test: Offline HTML fixtures with navigation outside article, body-before-article, repeated intentional dialogue, br-only chapters, short CJK lines, nested li/p and advertisements; assert exact retained prose and no global repeated-text loss.

findings.claim: Source-kind cache invalidates only on source count and first/last URLs. Editing an interior source kind or replacing an interior source with the same collection shape leaves the row badge and kind filter stale.
findings.fix: Use an explicit monotonically increasing SourceStore revision or update the immutable URL-to-kind map when the source store publishes a change. Do not hash the entire collection per row.
findings.test: Same count/first/last, mutate middle source text-to-comic and replace middle URL; assert badge/filter maps update without rebinding screen.

findings.claim: In-flight image tasks include headers in identity, but completed full/thumbnail caches use only URL and size. Two credential- or Referer-dependent responses for the same URL can reuse the wrong image. CachedRemoteImage also leaves the previous image visible when a taskIdentifier changes until the new load finishes.
findings.fix: Use a consistent normalized request identity for cache and in-flight lookup; maintain synchronous no-header API for existing layout callers. Clear or replace stale view image on request identity change, and guard cached assignments against cancellation/generation as well as downloaded assignments.
findings.test: Mock URLProtocol returns distinct images for same URL with two headers, validate separate caches/dedup; rapidly change row URL while first task is delayed and assert no stale assignment.

findings.claim: The detached TOC extension captures the old source/detail, then later writes self.chapters if it is merely longer. There is no selected book/source generation check and the cache bookURL comes from mutable self.book. Switching sources or reloading can publish a stale TOC and save it under the newly selected book URL.
findings.fix: Capture immutable sourceURL/bookURL/request generation, retain/cancel task handles, recheck all identities after await and before publishing/cache writes. Longer count alone is not identity or correctness validation.
findings.test: Delayed TOC for source A, switch to source B and finish B, release longer A; assert B chapters remain and A response is never stored in B cache key.

negative_findings: No Core/Rules/RuleEngine.swift exists in this snapshot. Actual entry points are Core/Engine/SourceEngine.swift, class LegadoSourceEngine.
LegadoSourceEngine is not @MainActor and is not a single serial actor; source review does not support claiming all parsing/network runs on the UI actor.

RemoteImageLoader already deduplicates in-flight work, downsamples thumbnails and decodes on a global queue. The remaining search hitch must not be attributed to full-size-main-thread image decoding without trace evidence.
The earlier 119 pagination warmup already uses task-group child work off MainActor. Do not reintroduce main-thread pagination as an alleged fix.

No new iOS 17-only dependency is necessary for these repairs. FlowLayout/custom Layout, WKWebView, structured concurrency and NavigationStack have an iOS 16 path; native iOS 16 compile plus UI fixtures are still required.
